template: We are on the Grafana dashboard '{{v1}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{v2}}). The dashboard's auto-refresh interval currently shows {{v3}} in the header but the 'refresh' field is NOT persisted in the saved dashboard JSON. Persist it: First try changing the refresh interval via the time picker dropdown (set it to 5m, then back to {{v3}}) and check whether the '' header button becomes enabled; if so, save the dashboard. If the save dialog reports '' or the refresh still isn't persisted, then instead open the dashboard Settings (gear icon, top-right), click 'JSON Model' in the left nav, and edit the JSON to add a top-level field "refresh": "{{v3}}" (place it right after the "tags" field), then click 'Save changes' and confirm. Finally verify by fetching /api/dashboards/uid/{{v2}} in the page and report the exact value of the 'refresh' field, plus title, tags, and time.
